questions.stem: Which of the following is a satellite of Earth?
questions.solution: The Moon is a satellite of Earth because it orbits the planet. Sirius is a star, not a satellite. Venus and Mars are planets, not satellites of Earth.

questions.stem: Why do stars other than the Sun appear as bright dots in the night sky?
choices: They are too far away from Earth
They are smaller than the Sun
They are not visible during the day
questions.solution: Stars other than the Sun appear as bright dots because they are extremely far away from Earth, making them look small despite their actual size and brightness. The other options are incorrect because the size of a star relative to the Sun or its brightness does not explain why it appears as a dot. The visibility of stars during the day is unrelated to their appearance as dots in the night sky.

hi.solution: सूर्य के अलावा तारे चमकीले बिंदु के रूप में दिखाई देते हैं क्योंकि वे पृथ्वी से अत्यधिक दूर हैं, जिसके कारण उनके वास्तविक आकार और चमक के बावजूद वे छोटे दिखाई देते हैं। अन्य विकल्प गलत हैं क्योंकि एक तारे का सूर्य के मुकाबले आकार या चमक उसके बिंदु के रूप में दिखाई देने की व्याख्या नहीं करता है। दिन में तारों की दृश्यता रात के आकाश में उनके बिंदु के रूप में दिखाई देने से संबंधित नहीं है।

questions.stem: What is the name of the region where most asteroids are found?
questions.solution: The region where most asteroids are found is called the asteroid belt, as it is the area between the orbits of Mars and Jupiter where the majority of asteroids reside. The other options, such as Comet Zone, Galaxy Region, and Solar System, do not specifically refer to this area. The Solar System is a much broader term, and Comet Zone is not a recognized scientific term for asteroid locations.

questions.stem: Which of the following is a famous comet that appears every 76 years?
questions.solution: Halley’s Comet is known for its periodic appearance every 76 years, making it the correct answer. Comet Hale-Bopp, Comet Lovejoy, and Comet NEAT do not have this specific 76-year orbital period. The other comets have different orbital periods or are not recognized for this particular cycle.

questions.stem: What is the primary reason for the tail of a comet?
questions.solution: The primary reason for the tail of a comet is evaporated material, which is released as the comet approaches the Sun and heats up. Reflection of sunlight, magnetic field, and gravity do not directly cause the formation of the tail. The tail is formed by the material that vaporizes from the comet's nucleus, not by external forces like gravity or magnetic fields.

hi.stem: एक धूमकेतु के पूंछ का प्राथमिक कारण क्या है?
hi.solution: एक धूमकेतु के पूंछ का प्राथमिक कारण उत्सर्जित सामग्री है, जो धूमकेतु के सूर्य के पास आने और गर्म होने पर छोड़ दी जाती है। प्रकाश के परावर्तन, चुंबकीय क्षेत्र और गुरुत्वाकर्षण धूमकेतु के पूंछ के निर्माण के सीधे कारण नहीं हैं। पूंछ धूमकेतु के नाभिक से वाष्पित सामग्री द्वारा बनती है, गुरुत्वाकर्षण या चुंबकीय क्षेत्र जैसे बाहरी बलों द्वारा नहीं।

questions.stem: Why is the Sun able to appear larger and brighter than other stars, even though some stars are larger than the Sun?
choices: Because the Sun is the only star that can be seen during the day
Because the Sun is closer to Earth than other stars
Because the Sun is made of gases
Because the Sun is the only star that gives light and heat
questions.solution: The Sun appears larger and brighter than other stars because it is much closer to Earth, which makes it seem bigger and brighter despite some stars being physically larger. The other options are incorrect because the visibility of the Sun during the day, its composition of gases, and its role in providing light and heat do not explain its apparent size and brightness compared to other stars.

questions.stem: Why is Pluto no longer classified as a planet?

hi.stem: प्लूटो को ग्रह के रूप में वर्गीकृत क्यों नहीं किया जाता है?
choices: क्योंकि यह सूर्य के चारों ओर घूमता नहीं है
क्योंकि यह अपना कक्ष नहीं साफ कर सका है
hi.solution: सही उत्तर यह है कि यह अपना कक्ष नहीं साफ कर सका है। यह एक मुख्य मानदंड है, क्योंकि इसका अर्थ है कि प्लूटो अपने कक्ष मार्ग में अन्य वस्तुओं के साथ साझा करता है। अन्य विकल्प गलत हैं क्योंकि आकार, सूर्य के चारों ओर घूमना और आकृति मुख्य कारण नहीं हैं।
hi.critique: Translation is accurate and maintains the original meaning, with appropriate Hindi scientific terminology used.

mr.stem: प्लूटो आता ग्रह म्हणून वर्गीकृत का नाही?
choices: कारण त्याने आपला मार्ग साफ केलेला नाही
mr.solution: योग्य उत्तर हे आहे की त्याने आपला मार्ग साफ केलेला नाही. हे ग्रहाच्या वर्गीकरणाचे मुख्य अट आहे, कारण त्यामुळे प्लूटो इतर वस्तूंसह आपल्या कक्षेत असतो. इतर विकल्प चूक आहेत कारण आकार, सूर्याभोवती फिरणे आणि आकृती हे प्लूटोच्या पुनर्वर्गीकरणाचे प्रमुख कारण नाहीत.
